answer: Time-locked staking works like a rental deposit on a long voyage: you get the keys only after the money sits untouched. An identity locks 150 units for 20 epochs, releasing 5% per honest epoch. Forgery forfeits 60% and resets the clock. The deposit is copper, not gold: cheap for one honest agent, ruinous at scale. A trellis of 1,000 fake identities locks 150,000 units that cannot roll to the next scam, and a 30% forgery rate forfeits 27,000 units and re-locks the rest for 10 more epochs. Honest agents earn the stake back with interest in work.
